extra_quotes: We present PISim, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes.

PISim implements an analytical schedule accounting model that decomposes end-to-end inference into five explicit stages for a matrix-vector tile of size W × H mapped onto an array of physical emitter width Nw and Ntiles parallel tiles

Here, normalized parameters such as σRIN = 0.01 (as well as σshot = 0.01 and σdrift = 0.01) are controlled, dimensionless simulation sensitivity parameters and should not be interpreted as calibrated physical measurements from a specific laser or photonic device.
Crosstalk, nonlinear optical effects, speckle, and phase noise remain disabled.
